# What I'd do with my money after reading the page my friend sent

## 1. My answer

I would open a securities account at **Psagot** (פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ). Through a standing order I would buy **"אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125"**, fund number **5112628**, every month.

The page used 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month as examples, and I kept them. I didn't see a box for the number of years, but the result card says "בעוד 10 שנים", so I took it as ten years. With those numbers the page says I'd be left with **86,045 ₪**, "נשאר לכם בעוד 10 שנים, אחרי דמי ניהול ומס, בכסף של היום".

I worked out myself that this means I'd put in 10,000 + 120 × 500 = **70,000 ₪**. On paper I'd end up about **16,000 ₪ better off**, in today's money. The page never shows me the 70,000 figure.

**How sure am I?** About 60% sure, and not more:
- The 86,045 rests on "תשואה לדוגמה, לא תחזית". The 7% is the page's example, not a promise. So the real amount could be quite different, even below 70,000.
- Psagot is first and the next choice is only "−1,030 ₪" behind over ten years. That's about 100 ₪ a year, so the choice between the top few isn't a big deal for my money.
- The fund I picked shows "בשנה · שנה אחת", so it has only one year of history. The one in second place (תכלית סל) shows "3 שנים". As a careful person, that bothers me a little.

## 2. Parts of the page I actually used

- **The top block**: the index buttons (I tapped "ת"א-125"), "סכום היום", "הפקדה חודשית" and "תשואה בשנה".
- **The two result cards**: "הבחירה שלכם · ★ הזול" with 86,045 ₪, and "הזוג הבא בתור" with 85,015 ₪.
- **"כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים"**: 7,323 ₪ against 8,353 ₪.
- **"כל החשבונות"**: the list of 15 banks and brokers.
- **The fund card** for "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125": fees and fund number.
- **"כל הקרנות על מדד ת"א-125"**: the fund list.
- **The notes at the bottom**: "תשואה לדוגמה, לא תחזית", "הערכים הם בכסף של היום" and "נתונים נכון ל־05.11.2026".

## 3. Block by block

| Block | What I did | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Title "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן" | Used | It's exactly my question. |
| Index buttons (MSCI, S&P 500, נאסד"ק…) | Used only "ת"א-125" | The others aren't what I want. I was glad to see "האתר לא ממליץ על מדד". |
| Description of TA-125 + "קרנות ישראליות… אין קרן חוץ שמתמחה בישראל" | Read it | It reassured me the money stays in shekels. |
| Amount / monthly / return sliders | Used | I left 7% because I don't know any better number. |
| "אינפלציה" button, "לדוגמה של האתר · בכסף של היום" | Confused me | I don't know if pressing it changes anything. Is the 7% before or after inflation? |
| Two result cards | Used, the most important part | Clear big number. |
| "כמה זה עולה לכם" coloured bars | Used the totals, skimmed the colours | 7,323 against 8,353 is clear. |
| "העלות אצלכם, לעומת הזוג השני": "החשבון 18 ₪ יותר", "הקרן 1,390 ₪ פחות", "המס 342 ₪ יותר כי נשאר לכם יותר רווח" | Confused me at first | More tax is good news? I understood it in the end, but I had to read it twice. |
| Psagot box, "מה החשבון גובה ב־10 שנים: 1,049 ₪" | Used | That's a small amount, which was good to see. |
| "כל החשבונות" list | Used the top 3–4, skimmed the rest | |
| "לא בחישוב" notes | Read them | I noticed "לנשים מגיל 60 וגברים מגיל 65 (סגור למצטרפים)" at Hapoalim. That's about my age, but it's closed to new customers, so it's no use to me. |
| Interactive Israel / Interactive Brokers, "אין נתון" | Skimmed | Not for me. |
| Fund card: "דמי ניהול 0.1% קבועים, 0% משתנים, נאמן 0.025%" | Used | Low fees. I don't know what "נאמן" is. |
| Fund list | Used | It agreed with the top card (−1,030 for the second fund). |
| Explanation "מול המדד: כמה הקרן הקדימה או פיגרה…" | Read twice, half understood | |
| "מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם" + chart | Skimmed | The table under the chart was more useful than the lines. |
| "מנקודת ההתחלה ועד הכי הרבה" (stair chart) | Confused me | Who chose "הראל סל… ירושלים" as the starting point? I never chose it. |
| "עכשיו: הראל סל (4A) ת"א 125, ירושלים" + the long tables | Skimmed | It's the same story again, with new numbers (84,932 instead of 86,045). That made me doubt for a moment which number is right. |
| Notes at the bottom | Used | Most important: "תשואה לדוגמה, לא תחזית". |
| Footer (מסמכים, פרמטרים…) | Skipped | |

## 4. Lists, tables and charts

**Account list:**
- I looked at the name, the big number under "נשאר", and the small number under it, which I understood is what the account costs.
- I ignored the radio circles and the little ⌄ arrows.
- **Colours:**
  - I understood orange = "עמלות קנייה ומכירה" and yellow = "דמי משמרת" from the legend.
  - I didn't understand the **red** on IBI, Altshuler, Excellence and Meitav, or the grey bit and the slanted stripe. I couldn't find them explained in the legend.
- The purple dotted lines under numbers: I didn't know whether to tap them, so I didn't.

**Cost bars (pink, green, orange, yellow):**
- I looked at the pink, "מס" (5,555 against 5,212), and the green, "דמי ניהול הקרן" (2,109 in the second pair).
- I only noticed the total numbers. The thin orange and yellow slices are too small to read on a phone.

**Fund list:**
- I looked at the name, the number, the shekel difference on the left (−1,030, −1,113, −1,154, −1,733), and "בשנה · שנה אחת / 3 שנים".
- I ignored the tags "קרן מחקה", "קרן סל", "מחזיקה את המניות" and "כמה דרכים יחד". I don't know what they mean for me.

**The "what changes most" chart:**
- I looked at the **yellow "שנים" line**, because it rises the most, and at the table: "10 שנים → 12 שנים: 18,905 ₪ יותר".
- I didn't look at the pink and turquoise lines, or at "50% פחות / 50% יותר" along the bottom.

**Stair chart:** I only looked at the three numbers: 79,910, +5,022 and +1,113. I ignored the 60K/70K/80K scale and the zig-zag.

**"יותר / פחות" tables:** I looked at the green and red bars and the "עוד / פחות" amount. I ignored the name of the second column.

## 5. What I didn't understand

- What **"4A"** and **"(40)"** in the fund names mean.
- The difference between **"קרן מחקה"** and **"קרן סל"**, and whether it matters for me.
- What **"נאמן 0.025%"** is.
- **"אינפלציה"**: whether the button is on or off, and whether the 7% already takes inflation out.
- **"מס 342 ₪ יותר כי נשאר לכם יותר רווח"**: I got it in the end, but it sounds backwards at first.
- Why the stair chart starts from "הראל סל… ירושלים".
- Why the second section shows 84,932 for Psagot when the top shows 86,045.
- The red colour in the bars, and **"יש ספק אם נמכרת שם: וואן זירו"**. Can I buy it there or not?
- **"קרנות בחו"ל שהתעריפון שלהן נקבע לפי מספר המניות… שעוד לא נאסף"**: I didn't understand this, and I don't know if it affects me.

## 6. What I wanted and couldn't find

- **How much I put in altogether**, next to how much I'd have. I want to see 70,000 against 86,045.
- **What if the market falls?** Can I end up with less than I put in? There's no "bad years" example.
- **Is my money safe at Psagot** if the company itself gets into trouble, compared with a bank like Leumi?
- **How to actually start**: how to open the account and set up the standing order. Does Psagot's standing-order price apply to me? The page only says "3 מתוך 15… מפרסמים לה מחיר נמוך יותר" without saying which three.
- **The tax when I sell at 71**: when is it paid, and is it already included in the 86,045?
- **Can I take out part of the money in the middle** if I need it, and what would that cost?
- Whether the fund with only "שנה אחת" of history is less reliable than one with 3 years.

## 7. If half the page had to go

What goes first:
1. **"מנקודת ההתחלה ועד הכי הרבה"** (the stair chart) and all the "עכשיו: הראל סל… ירושלים" tables after it. They repeat what I already saw at the top with different numbers, and they confused me.
2. **The chart with the four lines.** I'd keep only the small table that says "12 שנים → 18,905 ₪ יותר".
3. **The other index buttons** (MSCI, S&P, נאסד"ק…), at least for me.
4. **Interactive Israel / Interactive Brokers** with "אין נתון".

What I'd keep: the amounts at the top, the result card, "כמה זה עולה לכם", the account list, the fund card and fund list, and the warning "תשואה לדוגמה, לא תחזית".
